data.long_description:
Provident Estates is proud to present this exceptional beachfront residence in La Vie, one of the most prestigious developments in Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR). Offering a seamless blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal living, this beautifully appointed apartment boasts spectacular sea views and an enviable location along Dubai's iconic shoreline.

The property is currently tenanted and viewings can be arranged by prior appointment.

Property Highlights:

2 Spacious Bedrooms
3 Modern Bathrooms
Panoramic Sea Views
Prime JBR Address
Bright and Spacious Living Areas
Direct Access to the Beach
Nearby Amenities:

Jumeirah English Speaking School – Approximately 1.5 km
The Walk at JBR – Approximately 0.5 km
Dubai International Airport – Approximately 30 km
Designed with both style and functionality in mind, the apartment features an open-plan living and dining area, a contemporary kitchen fitted with premium built-in appliances, and generously sized bedrooms, including a walk-in closet in the primary suite.

Residents of La Vie enjoy a resort-inspired lifestyle with world-class facilities, direct beach access, and close proximity to an array of retail, dining, and entertainment destinations. Whether you are looking for a sophisticated primary residence or a high-quality investment opportunity, this property offers the perfect balance of luxury and convenience.

Contact Provident Estates today to learn more or to arrange a private viewing.
